items.question: How do I download a TikTok video?
items.answer: Open the TikTok app or tiktok.com, tap Share on the video, and choose Copy link. Paste the link into the box at the top of this page and pick HD or standard quality.

items.question: Will the saved video have a watermark?
items.answer: No. We give you back the original frame without the TikTok logo overlaid, so the video is ready to repost or save for later.

items.question: Is the downloader free?
items.answer: Yes. Every feature here is free. No sign up, no app to install, no credit card.

items.question: What video quality can I get?
items.answer: HD when the original was uploaded in HD, otherwise the highest quality TikTok stored for that post.

items.question: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
items.answer: Yes. The page is built mobile-first, so pasting and saving both work directly from your phone's browser.

items.question: How do I save TikTok audio as MP3?
items.answer: Paste a TikTok video link in the box at the top, then look for Save audio (MP3) in the result card. The audio downloads as an .mp3 file.

items.question: Does the MP3 have any watermark or voice tag?
items.answer: No. The MP3 is the clean original sound from the video, with nothing layered on top.

items.question: Can I extract music from any TikTok?
items.answer: Yes, as long as the post is public. Both regular videos and slideshow posts include the original audio track.

items.question: What is the MP3 quality?
items.answer: We use the highest quality audio stream TikTok serves. Most files come out around 128 kbps, which is plenty for sharing or remixing.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No. Everything runs in the browser. Paste the link, save the file, done.

items.question: How do I save photos from TikTok?
items.answer: Paste a link to a TikTok photo post. Each picture in the result card has its own Save button.

items.question: Are the photos full resolution?
items.answer: Yes. We serve the original-size image TikTok hosts, with no compression on our side.

items.question: Can I save all photos at once?
items.answer: Yes. Tap Download all photos and we will bundle every image into a single zip file.

items.question: Is the audio of the photo post included?
items.answer: The audio comes as a separate MP3 button right above the photo grid, so you can save it on its own.

items.question: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
items.answer: Yes. Pasting and saving both work directly from your phone's browser.

items.question: What is a TikTok carousel?
items.answer: A carousel, sometimes called a photo post or slideshow, is a TikTok post made of multiple photos instead of a single video.

items.question: How do I download a TikTok carousel?
items.answer: Paste the post link at the top of the page. We show every photo in a grid and offer a Download all button to bundle the whole set.

items.question: Will I get every photo in the post?
items.answer: Yes. The zip contains every image in the original order, in full quality.

items.question: Is the audio inside the zip?
items.answer: No, we keep the audio as a separate MP3 button so you can save it on its own without unpacking the zip.

items.question: Why are carousels sometimes called slideshows?
items.answer: Different apps use different names. The data is the same: a TikTok post made of several photos.
